newsitem.title: EGYPT: Ethiopia envoy thanks Egypt for Sudan policy.
newsitem.headline: Ethiopia envoy thanks Egypt for Sudan policy.

text.p: Ethiopian Transport and Communications Minister Abdulmejid Hussein thanked Egypt on Friday for its stand on the civil war raging in Sudan and which the Khartoum government has blamed on Ethiopia.

"We thank Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak for his statements that have calmed the situation especially after he said that Ethiopia did not interfere in the conflict in Sudan," Hussein told reporters on arrival at Cairo airport.
Sudan has charged hostile neighbours Ethiopia and Eritrea with sending troops across the border to fight with rebels waging a month-long offensive in the east and south.

Both countries deny involvement in the conflict and Mubarak, who says Sudan is harbouring gunmen who tried to kill him in Addis Ababa in 1995, also said he was sure that no foreign troops had entered Sudan.
Hussein said he would hold talks with Mubarak and also deliver a letter from Ethiopian President Negaso Gidada during his three-day visit to Egypt.

Last month, Sudanese Vice President Al-Zubeir Mohammad Saleh tried to get support from Egypt in the fighting and held talks with Mubarak. Relations between Sudan and Egypt have been strained since the assassination attempt.
